    e=e.strip()
    if e=='true':return 'false'

    if e.startswith('!(') and e.endswith(')') and balanced(e[2:-1]):return e[2:-1]
    if e.startswith('!') and SIMPLE.match(e[1:]):return e[1:]
    if SIMPLE.match(e):return '!'+e
    return '!('+e+')'

    d=0
    for c in s:
        d+= c=='('; d-= c==')'
        if d<0:return False
    return d==0
need=[]

    attrs,ws,end=m.group(1),m.group(2),m.group(3)
    label=None;out=''
    for a in ATTR.finditer(attrs):
        sp,name,val=a.groups()
        q=val[0] if val else '"';v=val[1:-1] if val else None
        if name=='label':label=v;lab_bound=False;continue
        if name=='[label]':label='{{ %s }}'%v;continue
        if name=='[disableTooltip]':out+=f'{sp}[tooltip]={q}{neg(v)}{q}'

            if re.search(r"'(info|success|warning)'",v):
                v=re.sub(r"'(info|success|warning)'",lambda x:"'%s'"%M[x.group(1)],v)
                out+=f'{sp}[tone]={q}{v}{q}'
            else:
                need.append(path);out+=f'{sp}[tone]={q}{v} | pillTone{q}'
        else:out+=a.group(0)
    assert label is not None,m.group(0)
    if label.startswith('{{'):pass
    return f'<app-pill{out}{ws}>{label}</app-pill>' if end=='/>' else f'<app-pill{out}{ws}>{label}'
for p in glob.glob('feature-*/*'):
    s=open(p).read()
    if '<app-pill' not in s or not p.endswith(('.ts','.html')):continue
    n=TAG.sub(lambda m:conv(m,p),s)
    open(p,'w').write(n)

    s=s.replace('import { PillComponent,','import { PillTonePipe } from "../../lib/pill-tone.pipe";\nimport { PillComponent,',1)

    open(t,'w').write(s)
